Temps réel

Immediate, live data exchange and update capability in logistics and transport, enabling stakeholders to access shipment or status information as events occur.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Temps réel?

In this glossary, Temps réel refers to: Immediate, live data exchange and update capability in logistics and transport, enabling stakeholders to access shipment or status information as events occur.

How is Temps réel used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Le suivi en temps réel permet aux expéditeurs et destinataires de surveiller instantanément les mouvements de fret et les exceptions via des plateformes intégrées."

Why does Temps réel matter in logistics?

Temps réel matters because it supports clear communication in Visibility and Tracking contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Temps réel?

Temps réel is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Temps réel belong to?

In this glossary, Temps réel is grouped under Visibility and Tracking. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

Immediate, live data exchange and update capability in logistics and transport, enabling stakeholders to access shipment or status information as events occur.

Operational example

Real time tracking allows shippers and consignees to monitor cargo movement and exceptions instantly via integrated platforms.

Localized term
